format: JSONL: id, case_type, reference_date, text, expected TravelRequestDraft (with the route fields of I4), expected_status; optional annotation
status_policy: expected_status is the reviewed label ready, needs_clarification or invalid of the deterministic validation; place resolution (places-v1) is applied afterwards by the application and is not part of this label
limitations: Synthetic cases are not representative of real traveller traffic.
Written for prompt travel-request-extraction-v2; it is only validated in I4 (--validate-only) and measured against Ollama in I5.
Exact match is intentionally strict; a valid Pydantic response may still be semantically wrong.
